extName.description: The product name, shown in the panel. Not translated.

extStoreName.message: Holdpad – Quick Notes & Notepad for Any Page
extStoreName.description: The listing title: the brand, then what it does. Chrome and the Web Store search on it.

extDescription.message: Take quick notes in a side panel on any page. Save selected text and links, search it all. Private, offline, no sign-up.
extDescription.description: The Web Store summary. At most 132 characters.

captureNothing.message: There was nothing to save from that click.

notSavedQuotaShort.message: Not saved — this device is out of space for notes. Export a backup and clear some notes.

notSavedQuota.message: Not saved — this device is out of space for notes. Export a backup from Settings, then clear some notes.

resizeHint.message: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.

errorNewerNote.message: This note was saved by a newer version of Holdpad. Update the extension to change it.

errorNoteGone.message: That note no longer exists on this device.

errorChangedElsewhere.message: This note changed in another window while you were editing.

errorTrashedElsewhere.message: This note was moved to Trash in another window while you were editing.

backupNotJson.message: That file is not valid JSON.

backupNotBackup.message: That file is not a Holdpad backup.

backupNotOurs.message: That file was not exported by Holdpad.

backupNoNotes.message: That backup has no notes list.

backupNewer.message: That backup was made by a newer version of Holdpad. Update the extension, then import again.

settingsOpenFailed.message: Could not open settings. Try the extension menu in Chrome.

nearQuota.message: Notes are using $1 of the 10 MB this device allows. Export a backup and clear what you no longer need.

keptSeparate.message: Kept as a separate note. Both versions are in your notes.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the text instead.

pinnedSkip.message: Pinned. Bulk cleanup will skip this note.

movedToTrash.message: Moved to Trash · recover for $1 days

deletedForever.message: Deleted. That one cannot be recovered.

movedManyOne.message: 1 note moved to Trash · recover for $1 days

movedManyOther.message: $1 notes moved to Trash · recover for $2 days

editCancelled.message: Edit cancelled. The original note is unchanged.

confirmClearOne.message: Move 1 unpinned note to Trash? Pinned notes stay. You can undo this.

confirmClearOther.message: Move $1 unpinned notes to Trash? Pinned notes stay. You can undo this.

editorPlaceholder.message: Keep it here for now. Type “- ” for a list, “# ” for a heading.

linkInvalid.message: Links must start with http://, https:// or mailto:.

statusError.message: Not saved. Your text is still here.

statusEditing.message: The original note is kept until you save changes.

statusIdle.message: Notes stay until you clear them.

saveSeparate.message: Save mine as a separate note

expandWritingHint.message: Expand writing area (hides the notes list)

searchLabel.message: Search notes, tags, text, and sources

tagChipLabel.message: Tag: $1. Show only notes with this tag

tagInputLabel.message: Tag for this note. Enter to save, Escape to cancel, empty to remove

emptyAllBody.message: Jot a thought above, or select text on any page and choose “Save selection to Holdpad”.

emptyPinnedBody.message: Pin a note to keep it at the top and out of bulk cleanup.

emptyTrashBody.message: Cleared notes wait here before they are removed.

emptySearchBody.message: Try a word from the note, its tag or its source.

optSubtitle.message: Appearance, backup and privacy · everything stays on this device

launcherOffDone.message: Quick-open button turned off, and site access given back to Chrome.

launcherDeclined.message: Site access was declined, so the button stays off. The toolbar icon and Alt+Shift+N still work.

launcherOnDone.message: Quick-open button turned on. It appears at the bottom-right of every page.

launcherRefused.message: Chrome refused the permission prompt. Nothing was changed.

exportedMdOne.message: Exported 1 note as Markdown. Trash is left out.

exportedMdOther.message: Exported $1 notes as Markdown. Trash is left out.

backupUnreadable.message: That backup could not be read.

secAppearanceDesc.message: Colours, mode and note text. Changes apply at once to the side panel, the in-page panel and this page.

secStorageDesc.message: What is stored, how much room it takes, and where it sits on disk.

storageP1.message: Notes are stored on this device by $1. There is no account and nothing is uploaded. This is local storage on your computer, not an encrypted vault — anyone who can use your Chrome profile can read these notes.

storageP2.message: On disk that is your Chrome profile folder, under $1, as a LevelDB database. The text is not encrypted.

storageWarn.message: Removing the extension deletes its local notes. Export a backup before you uninstall, reset Chrome, or move to another computer.

storageShare.message: $1 of the space Chrome gives this extension.

secBackupDesc.message: A plain JSON file with every note, Trash included. Import it to restore, or to move to another computer.

backupMdNote.message: To read your notes somewhere else — Obsidian, a document, an email — export them as Markdown instead. That file is for reading, not restoring: it cannot be imported back.

mergeExplainOne.message: Merge keeps whichever copy of a note was edited more recently. Replace deletes the 1 note on this device first.

mergeExplainOther.message: Merge keeps whichever copy of a note was edited more recently. Replace deletes the $1 notes on this device first.

secTrashDesc.message: Clearing a note moves it to Trash. Pinned notes are never included in bulk cleanup.

trashAfter.message: After that, notes in Trash are removed permanently.

secQuickOpenDesc.message: A small button at the bottom-right of every page, so the panel is one click away.

quickOpenP1.message: It is off by default for a reason: to draw a button on a page, the extension needs permission to run on that page, and the only way to have it everywhere is access to every site. Turning this on asks Chrome for that access. Turning it off hands the access straight back.

quickOpenStrong.message: This changes nothing about what is collected.

quickOpenP2.message: The button reads no page content and sends nothing anywhere — it draws an icon and listens for a click.

quickOpenToggle.message: Show the quick-open button on pages

quickOpenToggleHint.message: The panel genies out of it, and it steps aside while the panel is open.

quickOpenRevoked.message: Turned on, but site access has been revoked in Chrome, so the button is not showing. Tick this again to restore it.

secKeyboardDesc.message: Shortcuts that work in the panel.

keyCommit.message: Add a note or save an edit

keyEscape.message: Step back out of an edit, a search, or the panel

keyConflict.message: Chrome may already use Alt+Shift+N. Check and change it in Chrome's shortcut settings.

secPrivacyDesc.message: What the extension does, and does not, do.

privacy1.message: No account, no server, no analytics, and no network requests.

privacy2.message: Only what you explicitly save is captured — never a page you merely visit.

privacy3.message: Link previews and favicons are not fetched, so saving a link reveals nothing.

privacy4.message: Formatted notes are stripped to a small allowlist before they are saved and again before they are shown. Scripts, styles and embeds never survive, and code blocks are shown as text, never run.

privacy5.message: The extension is disabled in Incognito windows.

accentOwn.message: Each palette uses its own accent.

accentAdjusted.message: Adjusted slightly where needed so buttons and links stay readable in both light and dark.

accentAsPicked.message: Readable as picked in both light and dark.

noteFontHint.message: The editor and your saved notes

paletteSlate.message: Cool greys and a clear blue.

paletteHeather.message: Muted mauve, soft but high contrast.

paletteOchre.message: Parchment and amber, for long evenings.

paletteGraphite.message: High contrast, pure black and white.
